correctness.rationale: Reconstructed integral CH0 inverse for proper Hilbert–Chow rho_n: all geometric punctual fibers have an affine paving with one zero-dimensional cell and hence CH0=Z, while the generic fiber above each curve in Sym^n(S) admits a rational point using curvilinear local ideals over finite residue fields (characteristic zero). Taking the closure of a rational section over the normalized curve yields a birational lifted curve and transfers principal divisors, so rational equivalence lifts integrally. For q(S)=0, q(S^[n])=0 and Roitman torsion theorem on the smooth projective Hilbert scheme forces CH0 torsion-freeness; rho_* transports it to singular Sym^n. Applying Fantechi–Göttsche reported factorial-torsion difference then removes the ambiguity and gives both CSM/Euler series as asserted. Checked Cherednik Theorem 2.7 cell dimensions n−ell(lambda) in full PDF and K3 example binomial(25,2)=300, Hilbert coefficient 324. Crucial Fantechi–Göttsche latest preprint could not be independently inspected in full due unavailable arXiv PDF/OA and disconnected authorized institutional VPN; theorem-number usage is therefore a documented primary-source risk, not reason to fabricate a scientific contradiction.
